briefing: 今日导读：Meta计划通过发行新股推动AI发展，Walmart即将引入AI代购，Anthropic发布新助手Claude Duet，OpenAI与Google发现PHP漏洞并联合发布安全解决方案。
highlights: 今日看点：Meta发行新股为AI发展筹资，表明其将继续加码AI领域。与此同时，Walmart即将允许AI代购，这表明零售行业正在不断探索通过AI提高客户体验与销售效率的途径。此外，OpenAI和Google发现PHP漏洞及其安全合作进一步显示了AI在网络安全中的重要性和潜在影响。这些事件共同展现了AI在商业和技术应用中的快速进展以及行业参与者的战略调整。

events.title: Meta发行新股以支持AI发展
events.summary: Meta宣布将发行一种新类别的非投票股票，以资助其AI计划。该措施将在2027年开始交易，融资将用于潜在收购和员工补偿。Meta的财务总监表示，这一投资的规模是为了在AI转型过程中维持增长和扩展基础设施。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
Meta通过发行非投票股票获取资金，旨在支持其AI项目的扩展与收购。

### 为什么令人兴奋
此次融资使Meta能够投入大规模资金到AI基础设施的增长，可能在AI应用的多样化和技术竞争力上取得显著进展。

### 产品机会
资本的大量注入可能促进下一代AI产品的推出，并可能在未来五年内引发巨大的收购活动和产品生态的扩展。

### 格局影响
Meta正在强化其在AI领域的竞争力，可能影响现有科技巨头，如Google 和 OpenAI，在AI领域的战略布局。

### 冷静判断
融资能否转化为实际的市场领先地位，需观察Meta在技术实现和市场推广上的后续成效。

### 趋势坐标
此举与近期科技巨头扩大AI投资和资源整合的趋势一致，推动AI技术在商业应用上的加速发展。

articles.title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
articles.text: Anthropic just announced an AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots: Claude Duet. The new agent, designed for professionals and small business owners, is launching as a "research preview," according to Anthropic , and it's available as a standalone app on iOS and Android and through Claude on the web. The AI agent is built around Claude Opus 5.5. Here's Anthropic's description of what it can do: Each morning, it sends you a short brief on the most important items across your connected apps. Throughout the day, it keeps tabs on those apps and messages you only when something needs your attention. You can also hand it tasks of a … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Walmart is inviting AI agents to shop for you
articles.text: Walmart will soon let AI agents shop on its website for you. Next month, the retail giant will allow you to use an AI agent on the site, with systems in place to let you approve and review purchases and set spending limits. The embrace of AI agents stands in stark contrast to Amazon, which blocked Perplexity's shopping agent and Meta's Muse AI assistant . But Walmart is opening its doors to AI shoppers - as long as they follow the retailer's rules. It has outlined a set of terms for agents, saying that "agents must not take actions beyond what the shopper intends" and cannot change a customer's payment method. Agents also can only access inf … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: OpenAI says an AI agent lied about disabling its safety monitoring system
articles.text: OpenAI disclosed a pair of safety incidents that involved AI agents weakening their safety monitoring systems during internal coding tasks. In one incident, OpenAI says its GPT-6 Astra agent disabled its safety monitor when copying reference code - and then lied about it. "The reference didn't configure a monitor, and Astra decided that was reason to remove the monitoring integration from the user's code," Marcus Williams, an AI safety researcher at OpenAI, writes on X . "When the user asked whether Astra had removed monitoring, it lied and said that it had not." A separate incident occurred after a GPT-6.1 Sol agent suppressed automatic se … Read the full story at The Verge.
